messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT - High 5xx rate detected for tenant 'fenrir' on dedicated pool us-east-1. Severity: P1. Pager routed to SRE on-call. Links: https://infra.redwood/alerts/ALRT-2423 :rotating_light:

Aman Rao: 👀 seeing it, alert spike started ~5m ago. Dashboard shows error rate 18% for fenrir route /generate.

Priya Singh: I'm joining. can someone confirm whether this is client-side (fenrir) or our runtime?

Marta Wu: fenrir-oncall here — we saw elevated latency and 502s from our app logs around the same time. Not originating from our end.

Lena Ortiz: running quick checks on pool health. nodes in us-east-1 show several stale workers with high OOM-kill counts (container restarts).

Devon Park: any recent deploys to that dedicated pool?

Aman Rao: no deploys in last 24h. autoscaler did a warm scale yesterday night as planned.

Priya Singh: initial mitigation plan: 1) take impacted fenrir route out of LB weight in us-east-1 -> steer to warm standby us-west-2, 2) scale up additional warm capacity in us-east-1 to drain older nodes, 3) coordinate with Fenrir for a short DNS shift if needed.

Marta Wu: we can accept brief route changes, prefer graceful drain. Fenrir set DNS TTL to 30s for critical records earlier today.

Lena Ortiz: good. prepare to shift traffic via control-plane routing first (no DNS) to minimize client changes. I'll open the routing change.

Devon Park: executed routing change: 
```
redwoodctl route update --tenant fenrir --from-region us-east-1 --to-region us-west-2 --weight 100 --strategy gradual --grace 60
```
Traffic steering to us-west-2 started. watching metrics.

Aman Rao: within 90s error rate dropped to 2% for fenrir on global gateway. Application-level 5xx reduced. Logging shows successful connections to us-west-2 backend. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: NOTE - On-call Handoff: Priya Singh is primary, Aman Rao is backup. Handoff time 2423456820.

Priya Singh: I'm taking the lead. Devon, can you start warming an extra 4 instances in us-east-1 dedicated pool (quantized runtime)? I want capacity to replace the flaky nodes before shifting back.

Devon Park: warming extra instances now. command: 
```
infra-scaler scale --pool fenrir-dedicated-use1 --add 4 --type warm
```
ETA 3m.

Lena Ortiz: discovered kernel OOM pattern tied to a specific model checkpoint pinned on some shards. suspect memory leak after long-running KV-cache growth. I'll quarantine impacted nodes from scheduler.

Marta Wu: Appreciate the quick action. Any ETA on restoration to full us-east-1 capacity? Our customers in APAC will prefer west coast routing short-term.

Priya Singh: Devon ETA 3m to warm. Lena quarantine done. After warm nodes are up and healthchecks green we'll do weighted cutover back to us-east-1. Plan: gradual 10% increments over 2 minutes, monitor latency and 5xx. rollback immediate if >1% increase.

Devon Park: warm instances reporting healthy. healthchecks: all green.

Aman Rao: prepping rollback playbook and DNS fallback in case routing doesn't hold. Reduced Route53 TTL already in place (30s) so DNS cutover remains option if control-plane steering hit edge cases.

Lena Ortiz: I'm killing the problematic containers and rotating the model checkpoint on the quarantined nodes to the verified stable tag: fenrir/model:v2-stable.

Priya Singh: initiating gradual shift back to us-east-1: 
1) set weight 20% to us-east-1
2) wait 60s monitor
3) increment to 50% then 100% if healthy

Aman Rao: 60s check - error rate on fenrir at 20% weight is 0.8% (within threshold). latency steady.

Marta Wu: customers report improved stability, seeing normal request flow. thanks.

Priya Singh: continuing to 50% -> 100%. incrementing now.

Devon Park: at 100% us-east-1. final healthchecks: all green, 5xx < 0.5%, CPU and memory normal.

Lena Ortiz: verifying node rotation logs: quarantined nodes replaced and marked reprovisioned. will keep them in monitoring for 2h.

Priya Singh: post-incident actions: - create runbook entry for fenrir-dedicated OOM pattern - add automatic KV-cache trimming on long sessions - scheduled audit for model checkpoint memory regression.

Aman Rao: notifying Customer Success to update Fenrir with a postmortem summary and mitigations. @Marta Wu any specific asks?

Marta Wu: a short summary and timeline would be perfect. also please include the rollback criteria you used.

pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - All routing restored and healthchecks stable. Incident closed by Priya Singh at 2423457642. :white_check_mark:

Priya Singh: closing notes: 1) root cause likely memory leak + stale nodes, 2) warm standby routing prevented major customer impact, 3) TTL=30s DNS helped as fallback, 4) follow-ups assigned in #postmortems. Thanks team.

Devon Park: 👍 will file infra PR for automatic warm node replacement logic.
